$comment: Pinned PDF font matrices. Client-known and build-fetched: the API downloads these at build time, the client downloads CJK packs at runtime from the same pins. googleFontsCommit makes every URL immutable; every file carries a sha256 the fetcher verifies. Re-pin on purpose (new commit + reader gate), never live.

serif-western.note: Bundled in the client (expo-asset), fetched into the API image at build.

serif-cjk-jp.note: Client runtime download on first CJK export; API ships it in the image.
